clips.title: The story
paras: Fray Island is a windswept, rocky islet lying just off the Merchant Coast of the Barrens. Dominated by privateers and a rough-and-tumble training ring, it is famous as a neutral haven where warriors from across Azeroth come to test their mettle.

Situated off the eastern bluffs of the Barrens, Fray Island is far removed from the watchful eyes of both Orgrimmar and Theramore. The island serves primarily as an outpost for the notorious Southsea Freebooters, who maintain encampments, docks, and drilling grounds across the crags. Amidst the rowdy pirate crews sits a fighting arena overseen by Klannoc Macleod, where seasoned fighters and raw recruits gather to compete in brutal brawls.
